intro: If you need a place to stay in Bangkok's Hua Mak–Ramkhamhaeng corridor that comes with your own kitchen, a private balcony, free parking and a genuinely affordable price tag — @Home Residence Bangkok on Soi Searee 2, Hua Mak, is worth a look. body.html: @Home Residence Bangkok sits at 1/1 Soi 16 Searee 2 Road, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi — tucked into a quiet residential soi not far from Ramkhamhaeng Road. The seven-storey, 50-room building is run independently with 24-hour security and CCTV throughout. The neighbourhood is a university-and-residential district on Bangkok's eastern side: low-traffic, local and a fair distance from the tourist bustle of Sukhumvit or Silom — which is exactly what many guests here are looking for.

The defining feature is an in-room kitchenette in every unit — a fridge, microwave and basic prep space — paired with a private balcony. Those two things combined lift this aparthotel above the standard box-room options in the area. Room categories are Studio Twin Bed (two singles), Studio Double Bed (queen) and Deluxe Double Room (queen, slightly larger). All are air-conditioned with an LCD TV and a private bathroom with hot-water shower.
"Clean room, friendly staff, peaceful surroundings — Wi-Fi stayed solid the whole time. Perfect for a week of remote work."

Guest ratings tell a consistent story. On Momondo (aggregating 285 reviews), cleanliness scores 9.5 out of 10 — the highest category — followed by staff at 9.3 and value at 9.2. On Booking.com (26 reviews, score 9.1 "Wonderful"), the free Wi-Fi earns a perfect 10.0 and location draws 8.7. Recurring praise: clean rooms that are larger than expected for the price, polite and responsive staff, and the calm of the residential soi after checking in.

Location context for first-time visitors: Rajamangala National Stadium is 1.2 km away on foot — Bangkok's east-side venue for big football matches and major concerts — making this one of the closest walkable hotels when there's an event. ABAC (Assumption University), Hua Mak campus is about 2.5 km away by car. Airport Rail Link (ARL) Hua Mak station is around 3.8 km; grab a rideshare in 10–15 minutes and you can ride straight to Makkasan or all the way to Suvarnabhumi Airport. Ramkhamhaeng University and The Mall Ramkhamhaeng are roughly 3–3.5 km to the west.

On-site amenities: a cafe, a small convenience store, laundry service, luggage storage and free private parking — a genuine plus in this part of Bangkok where street parking is limited. There is no swimming pool and no breakfast service, but the soi and the surrounding streets are lined with affordable student-district eating: noodle shops, street food stalls, halal options and casual restaurants within easy walking distance.

Honest observations from real reviews worth knowing before you book: some rooms receive limited natural light, particularly lower-floor units facing the narrow soi — request a higher floor if daylight matters. A handful of older rooms show signs of bathroom damp. The check-in window is 14:00–18:00, narrower than most hotels; if you arrive later, call ahead so staff can arrange key handover. A refundable ฿500 deposit is required on arrival.

@Home Residence Bangkok works best as a base for solo travellers or couples who want a kitchen-equipped room without paying serviced-apartment prices: ABAC students, remote workers on extended stays, business visitors with meetings in the Hua Mak–Ramkhamhaeng corridor, or concert-goers at Rajamangala who want to roll back after the show. At roughly ฿750–900 a night for a studio with balcony and kitchenette, the value-for-money case is strong.

highlights.title: Kitchen + Private Balcony in Every Room
highlights.text: Fridge, microwave and a private balcony come standard in all 50 units — rare at this price point and ideal for longer stays or anyone who likes cooking their own breakfast.

highlights.title: 7-Min Walk to Rajamangala Stadium
highlights.text: Bangkok's major east-side stadium and concert venue sits just 1.2 km away — no ride-share needed on event nights, and the hotel fills up fast when big shows are on.

highlights.title: Free Parking + 24-Hour Security
highlights.text: Free in-building parking plus round-the-clock security and CCTV — a practical edge in Hua Mak, where street parking is scarce and self-driving visitors are the norm.

honestSummary: @Home Residence Bangkok delivers genuinely good value for travellers who want a kitchen, a balcony and free parking in a quiet east Bangkok neighbourhood. Cleanliness and staff consistently earn high marks. The trade-offs are real: it's a residential-district location, there's no pool or breakfast, and check-in hours are narrower than average — but for the right guest it earns its 8.8 score.
honestChecks: If a swimming pool or buffet breakfast is non-negotiable — @Home Residence has neither. Nearby Wattana Place (Baan Thai Boutique) on Ramkhamhaeng Road offers both, including a halal breakfast option.
If natural light in your room matters to you — some lower-floor units face the narrow soi and can feel dim. Request an upper floor and mention your preference at check-in.
If you plan to arrive after 18:00 — the standard check-in window ends at 6 PM. Call or message the property in advance; staff can usually arrange a later handover if notified.

tips.title: Walk to Rajamangala for Events
tips.body: Rajamangala National Stadium is 1.2 km away — a comfortable 7–10-minute walk through the residential soi. On concert or match nights, this is the most convenient walkable address in the neighbourhood; book early as rooms fill quickly.

tips.title: ARL to the Airport or City Centre
tips.body: Grab a rideshare to ARL Hua Mak station (~10–15 min) and ride the Airport Rail Link direct to Makkasan for the city or straight to Suvarnabhumi — much cheaper than a taxi the whole way.

tips.title: Local Eating Around the Soi
tips.body: The lanes around Searee 2 and Ramkhamhaeng Road have affordable noodle shops, rice-and-curry spots, halal food stalls and casual cafes aimed at university students — excellent value. Your in-room fridge and microwave handle the rest.

tips.title: Arrange Late Check-in in Advance
tips.body: Standard check-in is 14:00–18:00. If your flight or schedule puts you arriving after 6 PM, contact the property before you travel — staff are generally flexible when given notice, but don't assume.

faq.q: How far is @Home Residence from Rajamangala Stadium?

Also well suited to ABAC or Ramkhamhaeng University students needing a longer stay, business visitors in the Hua Mak area, remote workers, and anyone attending an event at Rajamangala Stadium.
